description: Get ski trip recommendations based on dates, preferences, and conditions. Suggests best resorts for a given time period.

inputSchema.description: All fields are optional. Provide region and dates when possible for sharper recommendations.

dates.description: When you plan to travel — month name or date range, e.g. "February" or "Jan 15-22".

priority.description: Optional main trip priority (single value). Omit for best overall SnowSure score ranking.

region.description: Preferred ski region. Defaults to worldwide (any).

name: plan_ski_trip

markdown.description: Human-readable markdown summary of the tool result (may be omitted when structuredContent carries a typed payload; content[0].text always has the prose).

title: Plan a ski trip
